Regional influence

Battle (⚔️) costs 12 energy, sends your myth on an adventure to a random region for influence. Evolve needs battles, happiness, regional influence (per next form), discipline, and Combat BP. Spend relics from 🏺 for targeted influence. Lifespan slowly fades; deep sadness and ignored demands hasten the end. After death, the next life may inherit combat medals from how fiercely the last myth lived.

Evolution map

Map: Undiscovered forms appear as dark silhouettes (no details on tap). Forms you have played or evolved into stay revealed for that lineage, even across reincarnation. Tap a revealed icon to read its tale and view art; use Ascension requirements there to compare trial gates with your progress. Branching: At Rare→Epic you choose your epic form when you evolve if several paths exist. Epic→Legendary follows that choice. Evolution needs battles, happiness, regional influence (per path), discipline, and Combat BP. Use the 🏺 inventory to spend relics for influence.
